changelog:
Initial release of search-synthesis-expert skill.

- Introduces a structured three-phase workflow: Plan (decompose & strategize), Collect (browser-based search via Playwright), Review (synthesize & validate).
- Automates multi-source information gathering and synthesis using browser automation for deep research, technical investigation, and multi-source fact-checking.
- Outputs a comprehensive report including query, search strategy, source summaries, synthesized conclusions, and notes on limitations and gaps.
- Emphasizes principles of multi-source verification, source traceability, credibility assessment, and transparent disclosure of limitations.
